The '''I-a2b solar ionization reactor''' was a stardrive system developed and produced by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].<ref name="TSWTJ">''[[Star Wars Technical Journal]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
Often described as a "miniature sun", and incorporating one of the largest single [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperspace field generators]] ever designed, the massive reactor system occupied more than half of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer's]] interior. Unlike the reactor system on the older [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class]],<ref name="ROTS:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> the reactor on board ''Imperial''-class vessels was large enough relative to the rest of the ship to protrude with a ventral bulb. It also forced the troop and crew compartments to be located on the upper half of the superstructure.<ref name="SW:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

Like other heavy warships, it was the size of the power-plant which in turn dictated the size of the ''Imperator''-class.<ref name="HNN:AGD">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/hnn/001.html#rss|text=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided|int=HoloNet News — A Galaxy Divided}}</ref> [[Lira Wessex/Legends|Lira Wessex]] and her team at [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] designed the rest of the Star Destroyer around the Sienar drive systems.<ref name="TSWTJ" />
A version of the I-a2b was later adapted for use in the [[Bakura-class destroyer|''Bakura''-class destroyer]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> A smaller version of the I-a2b was used on smaller vessels, such as the Empire's [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE bomber]].<ref name="CompleteCross">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref>
